name: Keisei
source:
Tokugawa shogunate. Idyllic atmosphere of cherry blossom in spring. Each day passes like a dream around insults between prostitutes and their customers. I want to lift their burden and heal their wounds. Your love is waiting for you. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
德川幕府时代。春日樱花盛开，一片恬静安宁。在游女与客人之间的羞辱与争执中，每一天都如梦般流逝。我想卸下她们的重担，抚平她们的伤口。属于你的爱情，正等待着你。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
